# dpi-h-ra-translations

The gettext side of the DPI-H RA, one directory per target locale (ar, es, fr, ru, zh): a .pot template per document chapter, extracted once from folio/dpi-h-ra/ with the platform's extractor (pot-extract.ts), and the locale's .po drafts beside them. Every catalogue is UNOFFICIAL (agent drafts, no human sign-off; owner, 2026-11-18, option A). The glossary's translations are language-tagged labels in glossary/*.glossary.json instead (owner, 2026-11-18, card Q1 option 1), because the platform's glossary extractor takes authored terms only and every dpi-h-ra term is a candidate.

Part of [Reference Architecture and Guidance for Digital Public Infrastructure for the Health Sector](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `dpi-h-ra-translations`, holding `translation-sources`.
